title: 고유어 숫자: 하나, 둘, 셋… 몇 살이에요? 몇 개예요?
objective: By the end, you can use the native Korean numbers one to five, ten, and twenty. You can also use the short forms 한, 두, 세, 네 and 스무 before 개 (things) and 살 (age).
summary: Learn the native Korean numbers and use them to count things with 개 and say ages with 살.

task.title: Use native Korean numbers
task.line: Use the word list on page 1, and remember the short forms 한, 두, 세, 네, 스무 before 개 and 살.

words.meaning: one; becomes 한 before a counter (한 개, 한 살)
two; becomes 두 before a counter (두 개, 두 살)
three; becomes 세 before a counter (세 개, 세 살)
words.exampleMeaning: One, two, three! Say cheese! (said when taking a photo)

words.meaning: four; becomes 네 before a counter (네 개, 네 살)
words.exampleMeaning: There are four people in my family.

words.meaning: five; stays the same before a counter
words.exampleMeaning: Five people. (said when a restaurant worker asks how many are in your group)

words.meaning: ten; also used to tell the hour
twenty; becomes 스무 when nothing follows it but a counter (스무 살). 21 is 스물하나 (스물한 before a counter), 22 is 스물둘 (스물두 before a counter)
how many; used to ask about a number
counter for things; comes after the number
years old; comes after the number
words.exampleMeaning: My younger brother (or sister) is twenty.

exercises: Choose the right word: ① 우산이 (하나 / 한) 개 있어요. ② 우리 아들은 (셋 / 세) 살이에요. ③ 의자가 (넷 / 네) 개 있어요. ④ 우리 집은 고양이가 (둘 / 두)이에요.
Write the number in native Korean: ① 5 살 ② 10 개 ③ 20 살 ④ 22 살
Fill in the blank: A: 아이가 ____ 살이에요? B: 네 살이에요.
Fill in the blank with 개 or 살: ① 연필 세 ____ 주세요. ② 제 친구는 스물한 ____이에요.
Put the words in order to make a sentence: 개 / 사과가 / 있어요 / 다섯
Count in Korean and fill in the blanks: 하나, 둘, ____, 넷, ____
answers: ① 한 ② 세 ③ 네 ④ 둘
① 다섯 살 ② 열 개 ③ 스무 살 ④ 스물두 살
